Package: vis-network
Version: 10.1.2 (pinned in the root package.json)

Files:
  vis-network.min.js  <- standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js
  vis-network.min.css <- styles/vis-network.min.css

Source: fetched from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vis-network@10.1.2/ as a
one-time vendoring step on a machine without a local Node.js/npm install
available. jsdelivr serves the exact files published to the npm registry for
this package version (confirmed via the file's own header: "@version
10.1.2").

To re-vendor after a version bump (once Node is available):
  npm install --save-exact vis-network@<new-version>
  copy node_modules/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js -> vis-network.min.js
  copy node_modules/vis-network/styles/vis-network.min.css        -> vis-network.min.css

No build pipeline copies these automatically — this is a manual, documented
step, consistent with the viewer app not depending on a bundler.
